pages.text: The $(l)Underthrone$() is a dark realm under the world. Reach it through a Spire Gate once you have climbed $(l)floor 50$() of the Spire.$(br2)The $(l)Exile Camp$() is safe ground: blocks there can't be broken or placed, and it has vendors, tents and the $(l)Seal Gate$() under the north arch.
Gate and Spire bosses drop $(l)Crown Shards$() for SS/Paragon hunters. Seal gates add extra shards. Opening a seal costs shards.$(br2)Admins: $(l)/khaosnexus saga status|reset|camp <player>$().
